''(11 November)'' |matches=462 |total goals=974 |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason=[[2014 Primera B Nacional|2014]] |nextseason=[[2016 Primera B Nacional|2016]] |updated=18 November 2015 }} The '''2015 Argentine Primera B Nacional season''' was the 30th season of [[football in Argentina|Argentine]] second division, with a total of 22 competing teams. It began 14 February and ended 14 November 2015. Although there was some use of a different name earlier in the year, the [[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] has consistently used the Primera B Nacional moniker in releases of late.{{cite web|url=http://www.afa.org.ar/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=22532:oiuuy&catid=110&Itemid=100&lang=es|title=Fixture de Primera B Nacional 2015|publisher=AFA |access-date=24 December 2014}} ==Competition format== The league's format has changed from last season. This year there will be twenty-two teams which will play each other twice for a total of forty-two matches. In November 2014, the [[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] announced two teams from this season will be promoted to the [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]].{{cite web|url=http://www.afa.org.ar/upload/boletines/BOL_Comite_Ejecutivo_4978.pdf|title=Asociación del Fútbol Argentino Boletín 4978|access-date=14 October 2015 |publisher=AFA |language=es}} It was later reported that the champion will be promoted directly and positions 2-5 will compete in the "Torneo Reducido" for the second place after the regular season.{{cite web|url=http://www.diariopanorama.com/seccion/somosdeporte/futbol_1/asi-se-jugara-la-temporada-2015-del-torneo-nacional-b_a_50958|title=Así se jugará la temporada 2015 del Torneo Nacional B|publisher=diariopanorama.com |access-date=24 December 2014}} At the end of the season, four teams will be relegated.{{cite
